pages.title: Pound-Rebka Tower
pages.text: Gamma rays climbing a tower lose energy to gravity. A source moving at the right speed - less than a micrometre a second - puts them back in tune with the absorber above.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Built 1 to 8 storeys tall (7.5 m each). Set the Doppler drive to v = gH/c to cancel the gravitational shift, and count long enough that the shift stands five times above the counting error. Keep source and absorber at the same temperature: each kelvin between them shifts the line by 0.66 µm/s.

pages.name: Pound-Rebka Tower
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Gravitational Redshift Record.
